title: Memory Game Battle
prompt: Build a memory card matching game with multiple difficulty levels, a timer, move counter, and satisfying flip animations.

entries.name: Memory Match
entries.shortDescription: Classic card matching memory game with 3D flip animations, multiple difficulty levels, move counter, timer, and celebration effects. Train your memory!

entries.name: Orbit Memory Match
entries.shortDescription: Memorize and replay an expanding sequence on orbiting color nodes. Built for touch, mouse, and keyboard with responsive gameplay.

entries.name: Pattern Pulse Memory
entries.shortDescription: A polished Simon-style memory game with keyboard, mouse, and touch controls.

title: Decision Wheel Duel
prompt: Create a fun decision spinner wheel where users can add custom options, spin the wheel with realistic physics, and get a random result with celebratory animations.

entries.name: Lucky Decision Wheel
entries.shortDescription: Spin a polished weighted decision wheel to break ties, settle debates, and track your most frequent winners.

entries.name: Decision Spinner
entries.shortDescription: A polished weighted option spinner with touch/keyboard controls and fairness-aware winner history.

title: Sorting Visualizer Showdown
prompt: Build a sorting algorithm visualizer that lets users compare different sorting algorithms (bubble sort, merge sort, quick sort) side by side with animated bar charts, speed controls, and array size options.

entries.name: Sorting Algorithm Visualizer
entries.shortDescription: Interactive visualization of sorting algorithms including Bubble, Selection, Insertion, Merge, and Quick Sort. Watch algorithms sort data in real-time with comparison and swap tracking.

entries.name: Sorting Race Visualizer
entries.shortDescription: Pit two classic sorting algorithms against each other on identical data and watch their speed, comparisons, and swap counts update live.
